capabilities: Paste a video or audio URL and choose an output language
Generate video summary notes with overview, smart tags, highlights, and clickable timestamps
Generate speaker-labeled transcripts with consistent speaker colors and timestamps
Create and open a new note automatically from the ribbon icon or command palette
Embed the YouTube source video in the generated note when available
extras: The manifest carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README links out to WayinVideo for registration and API keys; processing happens in the external service, not locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a video or audio link into a summary or transcript note, so users must use outside tools and paste results manually.

relations.evidence: Create video summaries and speaker-labeled transcripts in Obsidian with WayinVideo.

summary: Service-backed plugin that sends a video or audio URL to WayinVideo and creates a note with a summary or speaker-labeled transcript.
